purpose: Teach: 踏み出す/言い換える/照らす/仕え/出くわし/入り込む/病ん/すすん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい挑戦に踏み出す勇気を応援するわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm rooting for you to have the courage to take this new step forward.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone with a tender undercurrent. Lean in slightly. Slow enough to let each word settle. The kind of support that doesn't demand a response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、難しい言葉を易しく言い換える練習してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been practicing how to explain hard things in easier words.
lines.style: Bright, earnest delivery. Small eagerness in the voice but not performed—genuine. Eyes up, looking to share something he's proud of. Natural childlike pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが寝室を月明かりで照らす日もあるわね
lines.en: Sho, there are nights when your father lights up the bedroom with moonlight, aren't there.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Distant gaze in the voice. Pacing unhurried, like remembering something tender. Trailing off on the question particle—not quite a question, more an observation shared quietly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに仕える気持ちでお手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to help Dad the way he helps me—like I'm serving him with my whole heart.
lines.style: Earnest and sincere without strain. Small voice but steady. Careful pronunciation on the important words. The simple conviction of a child who means what he says completely.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、街で先生に出くわしたら丁寧に挨拶しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, if you run into your teacher in town, remember to greet them politely, won't you.
lines.style: Gentle direction, not instruction. Warm but clear. A light touch on the reminder. The tone of someone who's said this before and will say it again without frustration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵本の世界に入り込むのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love it when I get lost in the world of picture books—it's like I'm really inside them.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. The lightness of a child sharing something he loves without self-consciousness. Quick, natural pace. Open vowels on the happy words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが病んでらした時、ぼくはお世話したよ
lines.en: Sho, when your father wasn't well, I took care of him the way he's always taken care of me.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Gentle but grounded—not fragile. The voice of someone remembering a small act of love that felt important. Steady pace, no apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、勉強がすすんでて嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm so happy—my studies are going really well now.
lines.style: Genuine, unguarded happiness. Light and open. A small brightness in the delivery. The satisfaction of a child who has worked and is seeing it pay off. Natural lift at the end.
